install_path.why_fallback_needed: This host's /opt/homebrew/ is owned by user 'alvin', not 'alfie', so 'brew install' fails with 'not writable by your user'. Operator can either (a) sudo chown /opt/homebrew, or (b) install from GitHub release binaries to ~/.local/bin/ (no system permissions needed).

issues_fixed_in_this_slice.issue: trivy 0.71+ only accepts ONE PATH arg per invocation; the script's 'trivy fs src/ training/ Dockerfile docker/' silently errored out and the 'docker/' path doesn't exist in this repo (Dockerfiles are at the root).
issues_fixed_in_this_slice.fix: Run 'trivy fs .' (whole repo root) and 'trivy config <df>' for each Dockerfile individually. Aggregate counts.

issues_fixed_in_this_slice.issue: gitleaks found 30 false positives (20 from the recent test file, 10 from old fixture data) because the 'generic-api-key' rule matches env-var-assignment patterns with token-like variable names.
issues_fixed_in_this_slice.fix: Renamed test values to obviously-fake 'test-token-{id,secret}-placeholder' (avoids the 'ak-/'as-' Modal prefix pattern). Added .gitleaks.toml with 6-file allowlist for the historical fixtures. Result: 0 leaks found.

issues_fixed_in_this_slice.issue: check_trivy only ran 'trivy fs' (deps). Did NOT scan Dockerfiles for misconfigurations ('DS-0002 running as root' is a real finding for 3 of 5 Dockerfiles).
issues_fixed_in_this_slice.fix: check_trivy now also runs 'trivy config <df>' for each Dockerfile. Aggregates HIGH/CRITICAL across both fs + config. Result: 3 real Dockerfile misconfigs surfaced (Dockerfile, Dockerfile.training, Dockerfile.ui — all run as root).
